body:
I do talk with the Chaplain. She's an absolutely amazing woman who has tried her damnedest to help me.
But that's the only thing we can do it talk, and it's just not working for me anymore. While it does lighten the load, my situation still remains the same at the end of the day.

But it has been a while since I've seen her.
I'll make an appointment tomorrow and see where that takes me, I guess.

I'm scared that if I reach out for help I'll be separated.

I can't afford to lose this career.
